lyrics_set.lyrics:
[Intro]
[Verse]
Neon signs blur in the rearview glass
Watching the city hours slowly pass
Coffee is cooling in a ceramic cup
Waiting for the moon to wake me up
[Pre-Chorus]
Shadows dancing on the bedroom wall
Catching my breath before the evening fall
[Chorus]
Lost in the rhythm of the midnight haze
Drifting through the velvet of the city maze
Every heartbeat echoes like a distant drum
Waiting for the morning light to come
[Verse]
Streetlights paint the road in golden lines
Finding the peace that the daylight finds
Tires hum a song against the cold asphalt
Time slows down, it comes to a halt
[Pre-Chorus]
Shadows dancing on the bedroom wall
Catching my breath before the evening fall
[Chorus]
Lost in the rhythm of the midnight haze
Drifting through the velvet of the city maze
Every heartbeat echoes like a distant drum
Waiting for the morning light to come
[Instrumental]
[Bridge]
Stars are whispers in a velvet sky
Watching the world as the clouds drift by
[Chorus]
Lost in the rhythm of the midnight haze
Drifting through the velvet of the city maze
Every heartbeat echoes like a distant drum
Waiting for the morning light to come
[Outro]
